caption:
Crop a passport photo at home 🪪

1️⃣ Open image.315tools.com and pick Passport photo
2️⃣ Choose your country and line up the head guide
3️⃣ Save one photo, or a 4×6 sheet of copies to print at a photo shop

Rules change and offices are strict, so check your authority's current requirements before you submit. Your photo never leaves your device.
